question: Estimate the annual revenue of a leading Indian fintech (Paytm).
idealClarificationQuestions: Includes payments + financial services + commerce + cloud? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Payments business (PG + UPI + soundbox + merchant fees): ~₹4,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Financial services (lending distribution commissions, insurance, MF distribution): ~₹2,500 Cr (down post-RBI restrictions on Paytm Payments Bank).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: FY24 was ₹9,978 Cr; FY25 dropped to ~₹6,800 Cr post-RBI action; FY26 recovery to ~₹8,500-9,500 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Payments business (PG + UPI + soundbox + merchant fees)
Commerce + cloud (ticketing, deals, ads, cloud services)

calculationFlow: Payments business (PG + UPI + soundbox + merchant fees): ~₹4,000 Cr.
